item.title: ToolJet
item.description: ToolJet is an open-source low-code platform that lets you build internal tools, dashboards, and admin panels by connecting to your databases and APIs — with drag-and-drop simplicity and full code extensibility.

item.title: Hoppscotch
item.description: Hoppscotch is a free, open-source, and privacy-first API development ecosystem that helps developers build, test, and debug APIs faster — right from the browser, no installation needed.
